name: Travancore

name: Andhra Pradesh

name: Karnataka
notes: Southern/central Karnataka excl. Hyderabad-Karnataka and Bombay-Karnataka districts, 2001 census scaled; Bangalore metro ~5.6M

name: Orissa
notes: Orissa (36.8M) + north coastal Andhra: Srikakulam, Vizianagaram, Visakhapatnam, E.Godavari (13.5M), 2001 census scaled

name: Hyderabad

name: Kolhapur

name: Nagpur
notes: Vidarbha (20.6M) + northern/central Chhattisgarh (15.4M) + Jabalpur-Mandla-Seoni-Balaghat MP (9.0M), 2001 census scaled

name: Gwalior
notes: Gwalior, Bhind, Morena, Sheopur, Datia, Tikamgarh, Chhatarpur, Sagar (MP) + Jhansi, Lalitpur (UP), 2001 census scaled. Removed undefined core CIP

name: Uttar Pradesh
notes: Uttar Pradesh excl. western NCR districts & Jhansi/Lalitpur (144.1M) + Kumaon & lower Garhwal (7.0M) + Baghelkhand MP (9.6M), 2001 census scaled

name: Delhi
notes: NCT Delhi (13.9M) + eastern Haryana (11.1M) + Patiala/Fatehgarh (2.4M) + Meerut, Ghaziabad, Noida, Bulandshahr, Aligarh, Muzaffarnagar etc. (19.4M), 2001 census scaled; Delhi metro ~13M

name: West Bengal
notes: West Bengal excl. Purulia (77.6M) + eastern Bihar: Purnia, Kosi, Bhagalpur divisions (17.2M) + Santhal Parganas (5.6M), 2001 census scaled; Kolkata metro ~13M

name: Bihar

name: Sikkim
notes: Sikkim (2001 census 0.54M), Indian since 1975. Removed undefined core SKK

name: Assam

name: Manipur
